name: Spectrum analyser
description: A hi-fi LED analyser: a ladder of segments per bar running green through amber to red, a cap that holds each bar's peak and then slides down, and the whole thing reflected in the gloss below the baseline. The bars are read off a curve through the six band followers, so the shape across the frame is a real spectrum at the resolution the analysis actually has.

bars.description: Columns across the frame. Past ~40 the segments are narrower than they are tall and it stops reading as a ladder.

detail.description: Per-bar deviation from the six-point curve, scaled by that bar's own level and by onset. 0 gives the honest interpolation and looks like a drawn curve; the default gives an analyser. Past ~0.7 neighbouring bars disagree more than the music does.

tint.description: Blends the green/amber/red ladder toward the project palette. 0 is a literal hi-fi meter, 1 is the palette alone and loses the meaning the colours carry.

reflect.description: Strength of the reflection below the baseline.
